terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && . .venv/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH="$(pwd)" && exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/frontend-app" && exec npm run dev
